ModbusCmd.Title: SmartPowerSensor Power
ModbusCmd.HintText: Measuring the power of the grid connection. Adopt the validiation if the power from/to the grid can exceed 25 kW

ModbusCmd.Title: Luna SOC
ModbusCmd.HintText: The state of charge of the battery in % from 0 to 100

ModbusCmd.Title: Luna Power
ModbusCmd.HintText: Charge/Discharge Power of the battery storage. Adopt the validation if the connected battery can provide more than 7,6 kW

ModbusCmd.Title: DC Power
ModbusCmd.HintText: Contains both the power arriving from the panels, as well as the power provided by the battery. Adopt the validation if more than 15kW can be provided by the system.
